intro: Welcome! Everything you need to know before you commit and before you arrive is right here. Please read it all — the important dates and the testing window matter.
A fully gated, resort-style estate — a deep pool with fountains, spa, sauna, cold plunge, gym, chef's kitchen, and lush grounds. This is where we'll live and shoot for the week.

detail: Life happens, and we completely understand if something comes up. If you need to cancel, we'll refund 50% of your payment as long as we have time to fill your spot. Keep in mind that if there are other cancellations, refunds are awarded in order of cancellation — for example, if two people canceled ahead of you, we'll need to fill three spots before your refund.

✂️ A note on editing — please plan to do your own
detail: We typically film 80+ collabs at each house — too much for our small team to edit in a short window. We are not responsible for editing; we're responsible for filming, organizing, and sharing all the files, plus cross-promotion. We'll eventually edit scenes and add them to the Dropbox folder, but since we don't edit until we're ready to post, that could be months out. Plan to do your own edits — and any edits you'd like to share back with us are greatly appreciated. We'll do the same.

sections.title: 2026 Mx. Pineapple Palm Springs Takeover
intro: Oct 9–11, 2026 — the weekend just before our house. Produced by Falcon | NakedSword, the Mx. Pineapple Palm Springs Takeover brings together adult entertainment, drag, and cabaret as a fundraiser for Pineapple Support — the free, 24/7 mental-health and therapy service for people working in the adult industry (over $100K raised to date). The weekend runs:

items.html: Fri 10/9 — VIP Pineapple Dinner

Sat 10/10 — Mx. Pineapple Cabaret: live vocals, drag, and surprises. 2026 talent includes Ana Foxx, Sister Roma, Ethylina Canne, headliner Brian Justin Crum (America's Got Talent / Broadway), Vanity Halston, Pippi Lovestocking, and more
Sun 10/11 — Pineapple Porn Disco & Pool Party (new this year): a T-dance and pool party with a renowned DJ, gogos, and drag
It's a great way to support the community — proceeds go to pineapplesupport.org — and to enjoy a few extra days in Palm Springs before the house.
We have 3 rooms available off-site for performers who'd like to come in early and take part. Want to add on the Pineapple weekend? Let us know and we'll share the details.
Questions? Reach out anytime — we're glad you're here.
